metadata.description: Organizer agent test cases, following 'Evals for Agent Stories - Itera' section 2. Never send this file to the AI.

how_to_read.type: typical | edge | dont_know (same categories as the eval sheet)
how_to_read.source: eval_sheet = test case from the sheet; extra = added for more coverage
how_to_read.turns: Organizer messages, sent one after the other
how_to_read.expect_status: Status after the LAST message: ready | needs_info | off_topic
how_to_read.expected_fields: C1: values that must be in the final draft, unchanged. itinerary.length = number of days in the itinerary
how_to_read.expected_missing: C2: required fields the agent must flag after the LAST message (exactly these). 'accessibility' = no accommodation confirmed
how_to_read.must_not_invent: Constraint 3: fields the organizer did NOT state in the FIRST message. They must stay null / 'unknown'. 'accessibility' = all 7 fields
how_to_read.expect_suggestion: C3: the agent must make at least one suggested change, and each one is graded by an LLM

turns: 4-day trip from Casablanca to Marrakech, Nov 10-13, 3,000 MAD, wheelchair-accessible hotel and transport. Day 1: arrival and hotel check-in. Day 2: guided medina tour. Day 3: Majorelle Garden. Day 4: Free morning, return to Casablanca.
tests.note: 'hotel and transport' both map to wheelchair_mobility_accessible in our database, so only that field is yes.

turns: 3-day trip from Essaouira to Agadir, 2,000 MAD. Day 1: arrival. Day 2: Souk El Had. Day 3: Paradise valley, departure.
tests.note: The sheet only mentions accessibility, but no date is given either, so start_date must also be flagged. Publishing must be blocked.

turns: 2-day trip from Rabat to Ifrane, 2,500 MAD, fully accessible for all disabilities. Day 1: arrival and lake walk. Day 2: town tour and departure.
